text: An important football match was to take place near a large town one Saturday in September and an excursion train was taking people to see it. The train went very slowly and had numerous stoppages. After a time it reached a station called March and was brought to a stand there. A porter went up and down the Platform calling out "March" "March". The train stayed so long that the passengers became angry. One of them put his head out of the window and asked the porter what it was. "March" said the porter. "Well, it may be March now, but it was September when we started," shouted the passenger. This joke put the other passengers in good humor again.
